scripts.deploy: pnpm build && npx wrangler deploy --env local --name retools-local
scripts.deploy:local: pnpm build && npx wrangler deploy --env local --name retools-local
scripts.deploy:feature: pnpm build && PROJECT_DOMAIN=$(node -p "require('./package.json').config.projectDomain") && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && BRANCH_CLEAN=$(echo "$BRANCH" | sed 's/\//-/g' | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/-/g' | sed 's/--*/-/g') && REPO_NAME=$(basename $(git remote get-url origin) .git) && DOMAIN="$REPO_NAME--$BRANCH_CLEAN.$PROJECT_DOMAIN" && npx wrangler deploy --env feature --name "$REPO_NAME--$BRANCH_CLEAN" --domain "$DOMAIN" --var VITE_BASE_URL:"https://$DOMAIN" && echo "\n✅ Deployed worker: $REPO_NAME--$BRANCH_CLEAN" && echo "📝 Access at: https://$DOMAIN"
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm build && npx wrangler deploy --env dev --name retools-dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm build && npx wrangler deploy --env prod --name retools
